working_capabilities.detail: requirements.yaml 구조/경로/gate baseline을 validate_requirements.py가 실제로 검증한다.
CLAUDE.md, README, memory schema가 Work Packet 운영 모델을 기준으로 정렬돼 있다.
requirements-validation.yml이 requirements validator 변경과 main push에서 gate를 수행한다.
운영 문서와 release evidence 생성기는 root memory를 우선 읽고 legacy memory/project를 fallback으로 사용한다.
stage:a~stage:e가 read-only JSON dry-run 결과를 반환한다.
project:status가 stage 상태, current WP, next WP, known issue를 구조화 출력한다.
HTTP transport, JSON parsing, caller headers, feature flag off-path 404까지 e2e smoke로 검증한다.
quality-gates.yml이 correctness, quality/security, supply-chain/operations gate를 분리 실행한다.
HOW_TO_USE와 root how-to가 legacy autopilot 대신 queue-driven Work Packet 흐름을 설명한다.
memory/stageA/video.yaml에 ubiquitous language, aggregate invariants, public contract path, risk profile, permissions, NFR이 있다.
billing 도메인은 openapi, events, capability, ui contract를 모두 갖추고 contract drift 검증에 포함된다.
wp:next/wp:status/wp:validate가 DAG dependency와 tier 순서를 해석한다.
wp:gaps가 desired_state, requirements, contract path 간 갭을 보고한다.
wp:health가 gate pass rate, change failure rate, avg WPs/session 기반 health rating을 계산한다.
wp:reconcile이 desired_state, working_capabilities, wp-queue coverage를 비교한다.
quality-gates.yml correctness job이 npm run wp:validate로 queue DAG 무결성을 CI에서 강제한다.
release-evidence.yml이 quality gates 후 SBOM, provenance, release evidence 생성 및 artifact upload를 자동 수행한다.
quality-gates.yml이 branch protection policy baseline validator를 실행하고 운영 문서가 같은 required checks 집합을 가리킨다.
contracts/events registry와 CloudEvents envelope가 domain event schema 및 produced_by 경로와 함께 contract drift validator로 검증된다.
ProblemDetails helper와 controller error mapping이 RFC 7807 형식의 JSON 응답을 제공한다.
FeatureFlagProvider와 createServer가 flag evaluation을 route wiring에 반영하고 flag-off는 404로 검증된다.
CreateTaskUseCase가 EventPublisher 포트를 통해 도메인 이벤트를 발행하고 InMemory/Outbox adapter가 존재한다.
telemetry.js와 createServer가 trace_id, RED-style metrics, structured logs를 남긴다.
SQLiteTaskRepository, schema.sql, db:migrate:test, infrastructure test가 task repository persistence baseline을 검증한다.
session:end가 gap detect → reconcile → health → ready WPs 출력까지 자동 수행한다.
contracts/events/envelope.schema.json과 registry.yaml이 중앙 이벤트 봉투/카탈로그 기준선을 제공한다.
test:contract가 task-tracking, billing, 중앙 event registry, CloudEvents envelope, produced_by 경로 정합성을 함께 검증한다.
validate:composition이 registry, navigation, catalog, feature flags, observability coherence를 검사한다.
lint, type-check, dependency/security baseline, rollback, sbom, provenance, controller smoke, network smoke gate가 연결돼 있다.
run_deployment_smoke.js와 deployment-smoke.yml이 실제 base URL 대상 health/task/billing smoke를 실행하고 JSON artifact를 남긴다.
README와 HOW_TO_USE entry guidance가 root memory, CI workflows, stage executor, deployment smoke posture와 다시 일치한다.
deployment-smoke workflow가 registry에 선언된 GitHub environment 이름과 환경 변수 해석 경로에 바인딩되고, validator가 drift를 CI에서 막는다.
원격 GitHub environment provisioning 정책이 저장소에 선언되고, audit template 생성기와 validator가 registry/policy/template drift를 CI에서 막는다.

desired_state.session-health-metrics: wp:health returns ELITE or HIGH rating with ≥95% gate pass rate
desired_state.release-evidence-automation: generate:release-evidence runs in GitHub Actions without manual trigger
desired_state.video-domain-stage-a: video domain has Stage A blueprint, risk profile, and contract skeleton
desired_state.billing-domain-contracts: billing domain has openapi, events, capability, and ui contracts at Stage A level
desired_state.cross-domain-event-bus: shared event envelope schema exists and contract drift validator covers the central registry
desired_state.self-improvement-loop: session end auto-runs gap detector and appends generated WPs to wp-queue.yaml
desired_state.rfc7807-error-standard: all controllers return Problem Details JSON; openapi.yaml has Problem schema; error tests pass
desired_state.feature-flag-runtime: server wiring evaluates flags.yaml at startup; flag=false returns 404 verified by test
desired_state.event-publishing: UseCase publishes domain events via EventPublisher port; InMemoryPublisher tested; OutboxPublisher stub exists
desired_state.opentelemetry-instrumentation: HTTP spans created per request with trace_id; task_created_total metric recorded; structured JSON logs emitted
desired_state.sqlite-persistence: SQLiteTaskRepository passes task repository tests; schema.sql present; migrate.js runs in CI
desired_state.wp-queue-ci-validation: quality-gates.yml runs npm run wp:validate on pull_request and main push
desired_state.branch-protection-ci: quality-gates.yml runs check:branch-protection-policy and documents required status checks
desired_state.deployment-environment-smoke-runner: operators can execute a real deployed-environment smoke runner locally or via workflow_dispatch with explicit target inputs and artifacted results
desired_state.deployment-environment-binding: deployment-smoke workflow binds to named GitHub environments declared in master-shell/operations/deployment-environments.yaml and resolves target inputs from environment vars or explicit override
desired_state.deployment-environment-provisioning-audi: operators can generate an audit template for remote GitHub deployment environments and CI validates registry/provisioning-policy drift without pretending live remote state is in git

decisions.decision: Retain memory/project as a legacy detail surface instead of deleting it
decisions.rationale: Existing scripts and historical evidence still reference these files, so truthful demotion is safer than removal.

decisions.decision: Move execution guidance to root memory and leave legacy files as fallback-only references
decisions.rationale: One canonical operator surface avoids state drift while preserving historical planning context.

recentWorklogs.goal: root entry docs를 현재 capability/CI/runtime 상태와 다시 일치시켜 다음 세션의 오판을 막는다.

decisions.decision: Limit the packet to root entry docs instead of broad HOW_TO_USE rewrite
decisions.rationale: README is the highest-risk operator entry point and had concrete false statements. A broader rewrite would expand scope without closing a higher-severity gap.

recentWorklogs.goal: 중앙 이벤트 registry와 CloudEvents envelope를 contract drift 검증에 연결한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the shared event contract static and file-based
decisions.rationale: A repository-local registry and envelope can be validated in CI without requiring a broker, schema registry, or runtime infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Use explicit billing event definitions instead of implicit oneOf-only variants
decisions.rationale: Explicit definitions give the central registry stable schema refs and make drift detection deterministic.

recentWorklogs.goal: root current-state에 release summary를 추가해 release evidence의 legacy fallback을 제거한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the release evidence artifact shape stable while moving its truth source into root current-state
decisions.rationale: Consumers keep the same JSON contract while the generator stops depending on legacy stage-era state.

decisions.decision: 이미 구현됐지만 packet evidence가 누락된 항목은 새 implementation packet을 만들지 않고 reconciliation packet에서 truthfully close한다
decisions.rationale: 구현/검증이 존재하는 상태에서 queue만 뒤처진 경우, 동일 기능을 다시 구현하는 것은 false work를 만든다.

decisions.decision: release-evidence-automation은 pass capability로 승격하고 manual placeholder는 deployment-environment-smoke로 대체한다
decisions.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow가 이미 존재하므로 manual 표시는 거짓이다. 반면 배포 환경 smoke는 실제로 아직 manual이다.

recentWorklogs.goal: legacy operator model이 남아 있는 template와 memory/project 문서를 root protocol과 정렬한다.

decisions.decision: Retain memory/project as a legacy detail surface instead of deleting it
decisions.rationale: Existing scripts and historical evidence still reference these files, so truthful demotion is safer than removal.

decisions.decision: Move execution guidance to root memory and leave legacy files as fallback-only references
decisions.rationale: One canonical operator surface avoids state drift while preserving historical planning context.

recentWorklogs.goal: root entry docs를 현재 capability/CI/runtime 상태와 다시 일치시켜 다음 세션의 오판을 막는다.

decisions.decision: Limit the packet to root entry docs instead of broad HOW_TO_USE rewrite
decisions.rationale: README is the highest-risk operator entry point and had concrete false statements. A broader rewrite would expand scope without closing a higher-severity gap.

recentWorklogs.goal: 중앙 이벤트 registry와 CloudEvents envelope를 contract drift 검증에 연결한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the shared event contract static and file-based
decisions.rationale: A repository-local registry and envelope can be validated in CI without requiring a broker, schema registry, or runtime infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Use explicit billing event definitions instead of implicit oneOf-only variants
decisions.rationale: Explicit definitions give the central registry stable schema refs and make drift detection deterministic.

recentWorklogs.goal: Reconcile orphan v2 capability claims with actual evidence and restore a green server wiring smoke baseline.

decisions.decision: 이미 구현됐지만 packet evidence가 누락된 항목은 새 implementation packet을 만들지 않고 reconciliation packet에서 truthfully close한다
decisions.rationale: 구현/검증이 존재하는 상태에서 queue만 뒤처진 경우, 동일 기능을 다시 구현하는 것은 false work를 만든다.

decisions.decision: release-evidence-automation은 pass capability로 승격하고 manual placeholder는 deployment-environment-smoke로 대체한다
decisions.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow가 이미 존재하므로 manual 표시는 거짓이다. 반면 배포 환경 smoke는 실제로 아직 manual이다.

recentWorklogs.goal: legacy operator model이 남아 있는 template와 memory/project 문서를 root protocol과 정렬한다.

decisions.decision: Retain memory/project as a legacy detail surface instead of deleting it
decisions.rationale: Existing scripts and historical evidence still reference these files, so truthful demotion is safer than removal.

decisions.decision: Move execution guidance to root memory and leave legacy files as fallback-only references
decisions.rationale: One canonical operator surface avoids state drift while preserving historical planning context.

recentWorklogs.goal: root entry docs를 현재 capability/CI/runtime 상태와 다시 일치시켜 다음 세션의 오판을 막는다.

decisions.decision: Limit the packet to root entry docs instead of broad HOW_TO_USE rewrite
decisions.rationale: README is the highest-risk operator entry point and had concrete false statements. A broader rewrite would expand scope without closing a higher-severity gap.

recentWorklogs.goal: 중앙 이벤트 registry와 CloudEvents envelope를 contract drift 검증에 연결한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the shared event contract static and file-based
decisions.rationale: A repository-local registry and envelope can be validated in CI without requiring a broker, schema registry, or runtime infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Use explicit billing event definitions instead of implicit oneOf-only variants
decisions.rationale: Explicit definitions give the central registry stable schema refs and make drift detection deterministic.

recentWorklogs.goal: legacy operator model이 남아 있는 template와 memory/project 문서를 root protocol과 정렬한다.

decisions.decision: Retain memory/project as a legacy detail surface instead of deleting it
decisions.rationale: Existing scripts and historical evidence still reference these files, so truthful demotion is safer than removal.

decisions.decision: Move execution guidance to root memory and leave legacy files as fallback-only references
decisions.rationale: One canonical operator surface avoids state drift while preserving historical planning context.

recentWorklogs.goal: root entry docs를 현재 capability/CI/runtime 상태와 다시 일치시켜 다음 세션의 오판을 막는다.

decisions.decision: Limit the packet to root entry docs instead of broad HOW_TO_USE rewrite
decisions.rationale: README is the highest-risk operator entry point and had concrete false statements. A broader rewrite would expand scope without closing a higher-severity gap.

recentWorklogs.goal: 중앙 이벤트 registry와 CloudEvents envelope를 contract drift 검증에 연결한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the shared event contract static and file-based
decisions.rationale: A repository-local registry and envelope can be validated in CI without requiring a broker, schema registry, or runtime infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Use explicit billing event definitions instead of implicit oneOf-only variants
decisions.rationale: Explicit definitions give the central registry stable schema refs and make drift detection deterministic.

recentWorklogs.goal: root current-state에 release summary를 추가해 release evidence의 legacy fallback을 제거한다.

decisions.decision: Keep the release evidence artifact shape stable while moving its truth source into root current-state
decisions.rationale: Consumers keep the same JSON contract while the generator stops depending on legacy stage-era state.
